name: locked-test-runtime-presence
definition: each test id a locked test file defines (read statically from the file) must appear in the runtime result listing, run, and not be skipped, deselected or reported xfail/unexpected-success, at every green/refactor commit and the range head; catches skips injected by config, conftest, hooks or imports that a source-marker diff cannot see. Adjacent to test-count-baseline and skip-count-baseline-delta, but bound to the locked test identities, not to counts or a committed result baseline

name: result-tally-consistency
definition: the per-test result lines of a run must agree with the runner's own summary (line count equals 'Ran N tests', per-outcome counts equal the failures/errors/skips tally; JUnit testcase count equals the suite's tests attribute; pytest line count equals the final tally); any mismatch means lines were added, removed or rewritten by the code under test and the run is refused as forged
evidence: fsantibanezleal/CAOS_Batuta@f854580 plugins/batuta/scripts/batuta_lib/tdd_history.py:487-511 (check_unittest_run), :514-537 (check_junit, check_pytest_summary), :387 duplicate result lines are forgery

name: runner-forgery-construct-scan
definition: a commit that introduces into any Python source a construct that patches the test runner, replaces sys.stdout/sys.stderr, or reads its parent process fails unless an approved change request names the file, because such code cannot be told apart from a forged test run; constructs already present at the base are warned once
evidence: fsantibanezleal/CAOS_Batuta@f854580 plugins/batuta/scripts/batuta_lib/tdd_history.py:872-898 (_forgery_rules), :858-870 (_scan_base); the detector test_markers.forgery_findings itself not read

name: changed-function-untested-block
definition: at Stop, each function changed in the diff is classified by whether any test executes it (execution denominator) or names it; with the policy set to block, a changed function no test executes blocks the done-claim once. Runtime-coverage counterpart of paired-test-per-public-function, which matches names statically at write time
evidence: beepometer/gutcheck@5ab0f08 mutation/gate.mjs:256-261 (untestedRowsOf, GUTCHECK_UNTESTED=block), :281-286 (execution denominator wording), :304-305, :364-368 (block on untested changed functions)

name: implementation-echo-literal-check
definition: at commit, push, PR or ticket close, changed tests are compared with changed production files and blocked when the same generated/opaque literal appears in both (the test asserts a value copied from the implementation) or when a changed test asserts only mock/private interactions with no outcome. A coded the row as static-test-oracle-check; the literal echo check is cross-file (test vs production diff), which that definition does not cover
evidence: alexander-vyh/escapement@1131185 claude/hooks/implementation_echo_test_gate.py:3-11 (landing-time scanner, two high-confidence echo patterns), :37-50 (git change scope, data-fixture echo)
